# JetBrains Mono ExtraBold

`Qwixit/Assets.xcassets/JetBrainsMonoExtraBold.dataset/JetBrainsMono-ExtraBold.ttf` is the static ExtraBold font from the [official JetBrains Mono repository](https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono/blob/master/fonts/ttf/JetBrainsMono-ExtraBold.ttf). It is used only by the compact Fix clipboard note and is loaded from the app bundle without registering it as a system or app-wide font.

- SHA-256: `ee43f7507a07ed15c4bf6211d5cc78fa0bacca58e7afbc170f4b1e38a5d0cde4`
